dispositions.assessment: Element ID 0x80 is accepted, as also updated by RFC9559; chapter displays exercise it. This is not a claim of a complete generic EBML validator.

DateUTC retains exact signed source nanoseconds; the separate native UTC view uses the 2001 epoch and fixed-length days. Epoch, negative/positive dates, leap-calendar dates and both signed extremes are selected cases. Reported clarifications are not relabelled Verified.

XML schema grammar/default terminology and document naming/rejected proposals reviewed. The library is not an XML schema compiler. Unknown source bytes stay retained; full EBML module conformance remains open.
AttachmentLink remains opaque in the complete source TrackEntry, including repeated occurrences; no typed attachment-link executor or complete TrackEntry semantic validation is claimed.

Cues keep stored cluster-plus-block ticks separate from codec delay, discard padding and playback preroll. Existing source-time and fresh/EOF seek comparisons exercise the selected delay/preroll behavior; CodecState seek remains open.
